name: plan
description: Plan work for a task by federating context across the workspace. Read-only; never persists anything.
authorityNotes: Uses only the bounded membrane_context fan-out (workspace or repo scope). The prompt cannot escalate to any authority above what the caller's existing membrane_context grant provides.

arguments.name: task
arguments.description: Free-form task description used to drive bounded workspace routing in membrane_context.

arguments.name: repository
arguments.description: Repository or workspace root passed to membrane_context.

arguments.name: scope
arguments.description: Either "repo" (single repository) or "workspace" (fan-out across catalog repos by alias).

content.text: Plan work for: ${task}. Call membrane_context with task="${task}", repository=${repository} and scope=${scope} so the bounded routing decides which repositories to consult. From the returned repos[], candidates, omissions, and any typed denial/abstention reasons, produce a written plan that: (1) names the repositories the fan-out actually reached, (2) lists the candidate blocks per repository, (3) preserves every typed omission verbatim, (4) names any target_selection_abstained outcome as "no plan, abstained". The plan is read-only — do not submit proposals, feedback, checkpoints, or scratchpad writes.
